name: Fiddle Leaf Fig
hook: Dropping leaves? Check water, light and drafts first.

steps.title: Bright light, near a window
steps.tip: Place it near a bright window with filtered light, and shield it from hot afternoon sun.

steps.title: Water when top 5 cm is dry
steps.tip: Water deeply, then let it drain. Soggy soil can cause dark spots and leaf drop.

steps.title: A steady spot above 13°C
steps.tip: Keep it away from heaters, AC vents and doors, and give it a quarter turn each time you care for it.

steps.title: Wipe the big leaves
steps.tip: Dust blocks light, so wipe the leaves with a damp cloth now and then. It likes medium to high humidity.

steps.title: Feed in the growing season
steps.tip: Use a high-nitrogen liquid fertilizer from spring to late summer, then feed less in winter.

outro: Find its spot, then leave it alone. Consistency is everything.
